relations.title: CCP → Theme Park Chilling
relations.description: The Central Chilling Plant provides chilled water to theme park buildings. CCP electricity is not duplicated in individual ride building meters for chilling load.
watchFor: CCP usage spikes on hot days
CCP vs total park electricity ratio shifts

relations.title: HCCP → Hotel Chilling
relations.description: Hotel Chilling Plant handles cooling for hotel buildings. Hotel building rows reflect non-chilling consumption only.

relations.title: Solar → Electricity Offset
relations.description: Solar panels generate electricity during daylight hours. Total solar generation reduces net grid electricity demand but is tracked separately from building consumption meters.
watchFor: Solar generation vs total electricity consumption ratio
Seasonal solar output drops in cloudy/rainy months
Midday solar peaks vs CCP cooling load
